answer_1.quote: In this work, we investigate the potential of leveraging a supervised decision model for extractive decision-focused summarization.

answer_2.quote: Automatic metrics. We design evaluation metrics based on our three desiderata... Faithfulness to the original model prediction... Representativeness compared to the decision distribution... Text-only summary evaluation metrics...
automatic_metrics: SUM-QE for grammaticality, nonredundancy, referential clarity, focus, structure & coherence

answer_4.quote: We use Mechanical Turk to conduct our human evaluation... Participants are asked to predict which restaurant will be rated higher after 50 reviews based on the summaries...
answer_4.guideline: Participants viewed summaries for two restaurants and predicted which would have a higher future rating; they also completed an exit survey on usefulness.
